replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey Zelkharm,

Although you may not have been completely aware of your surroundings, I hit you I think 2-3 times then you instantly did /leave. This is your first offence and therefore the punishment only lasts for 1 day (should be over by 7:30pm BST). There is no point appealing it now since 1) I believe the punishment is correct and 2) It's an extremely short ban. 

If you have any questions feel free to ask but if you don't I'll just go ahead and lock this.

Thanks, Spookeh.
